messages:
emily: Quick Q — can someone confirm who can approve this PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842

It updates infra/k8s.yaml (resource limits + SA) and runtime/serve/route.go (small routing tweak). It's blocking a canary rollout. I think CODEOWNERS might have rotated.

sam: I can review the runtime code, but I don't have infra perms to sign CODEOWNERS. @chris or @jen usually handle infra.

chris: I'm OOO today but I was on infra recently. FWIW our CODEOWNERS has these lines:

```
/infra/ @infra-team @chris
/runtime/serve/ @runtime-team @sam @emily
```

If those files are correct, infra approval would need @infra-team or @chris/@jen. @jen can probably approve while I'm out.

jen: I can take the infra approval if it's only k8s config and service account changes. Will skim now. @kev for security signoff? Any secret KMS changes in this PR?

emily: No KMS changes. Just namespace RBAC tweak and cpu/memory bumps. I added a note in the PR description about why limits went up and perf testing results. @sam the runtime change is tiny — can you confirm it's safe to fallback to previous route if needed? There's a small feature flag.

sam: Looks fine, I tested locally. Fallback path exists. I'll leave a review approving runtime portion. @jen once you give infra sign-off we can merge and trigger the canary.

kev: quick glance from security — no creds or new scopes. Approve from sec side :+1:

jen: Approved infra portion. Left one nit about a comment. @emily could you address and then @chris or infra-team can merge while he's OOO? If infra-team is available they can click merge.

emily: Addressed the nit and pushed a fix.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: all checks passed, canary target available in us-west-2, no blocking alerts.

sam: I'll mark my review approved now.

emily: thanks all — pinging infra-team for merge if someone is around. If not, @chris please merge when you're back tomorrow.

chris: noted, will merge first thing tomorrow if not merged already. Thanks everyone!
